wing: Binary-first SENS / Core4-free physical T5 execution
question: How does real physically validated T5 execute on a bare SENS runtime, and what repeated-work cost is avoided by one-time preparation?
claim: Measures same-code exact D1/D3 parity for physical and visible D2 execution plus a separate one-time-validated immutable T5 program reused across sessions. Raw paired samples and prepare-once cost are reported. Reuse is not equal-work decoder speedup; no Core4 bootstrap, AOT, GPU/FPGA or cross-language claim.
